data.escalation_detail: Five of fifteen acceptance scenarios remain uncovered or incomplete and branch coverage was not measured; three complementary assessments were obtained.
data.coverage_gap_reason: S05 malformed TOML, S08 full installation/profile/CLI precedence, S09 all enum variants, S14 every unsupported option, and S15 cross-platform/manual sample-copy behavior lack complete runtime evidence.
data.rationale: Accept the test report with explicit residual-risk exceptions and route to independent Reviewer. A and C vote accept-with-risk; B votes repair because five scenarios remain incomplete, especially config precedence, enum coverage, unsupported options, malformed TOML, and cross-platform/manual installation behavior. The escalated threshold requires at least two accept-with-risk votes and is met. The implementation event revision 14/digest 914ae9b1043fa69226b2c7e00fed2ff4c2efe7b7e9ffad7f84c56ae8f83ad537 is the tested snapshot; revision 15/digest 8a27b890461b8899f79a646f6814a4031afe6fb3407b2892169b579deb5d981e is the subsequent test-report handoff state.
data.exceptions: Explicitly accept transition to Reviewer with S05/S08/S09/S14/S15 incomplete, Linux/WSL profile paths unrun, and branch coverage not measured. These are verification exceptions only; no uncovered behavior is represented as passed.
data.residual_risk: Configuration syntax and full precedence, all enum variants, unsupported flags beyond --clipboard, cross-platform profile paths, sample-copy/no-overwrite behavior, branch coverage, real API quality, and model availability remain unverified. Reviewer must verify disclosure and check for other undisclosed evidence defects.
